The person
behind the code.

Hi, I'm Amira! I'm pursuing an Honours BSc in Computer Science with a Cybersecurity minor at Toronto Metropolitan University, graduating in April 2027.

I've worked in application management, machine learning research, and coding education. I love the mix of practical problem solving and collaboration, learning how systems work, improving them, and helping people along the way.

PROJECT / 04 · APR–MAY 2024

TMUber System

Built a ridesharing and food delivery platform in Java, handling 100+ test cases across registration, fares, and dynamic ride assignment. Applied OOP, driver matching, and shortest path algorithms to improve functionality.

PROJECT / 05 · BUILT ALONGSIDE CO OP SUPPORT

Cypress — Civic Issue Reporting System

Built with a team a Java command line platform for Toronto residents to report and track potholes, graffiti, and streetlight outages. Added citizen/admin authentication, location based duplicate checks within 100 metres, report histories, and admin filtering and status updates.
